opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Services
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide FJC Immigration Legal Services to its clients under a renewal procurement vehicle.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide core civil legal services focused on immigration law to survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence and their children at the city’s five Family Justice Centers. The services include legal screening, advice, representation before immigration agencies and courts, and support for self‑represented clients. This renewal is being executed as a standard renewal procurement vehicle.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Family Law Legal Services
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.summary: The City will renew a contract to provide family‑law civil legal services at the five New York City Family Justice Centers for survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence. Services include legal screening, advice, assistance with self‑filed petitions and full representation in court for matters such as divorce, custody, visitation, and support. The award is a renewal under the Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration procurement vehicle.

opportunities.title: The Arches program, which targets high-crime neighborhoods. Procurement is for human client services, as such Competitive Sealed Proposals is the most appropriate source selection method. E jy17 ARCHE
opportunities.summary: The agency is procuring human client services for the Arches program in high‑crime neighborhoods (awarded to Youth Justice Network) and permanent supportive congregate housing and related services for HIV/AIDS clients with mental health or substance‑use needs (awarded to Harlem United Community AIDS Center), as well as Family Justice Center immigration legal services (awarded to Sanctuary for). All contracts are being awarded under Competitive Sealed Proposals.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is seeking three vendors to provide in‑person and video remote interpreting for spoken languages, deaf/hard‑of‑hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation. These services support ACS compliance with local and federal accessibility and civil rights laws for limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The contracts will be awarded via a competitive sealed‑proposal process for a term from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2029.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The NYC Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is soliciting a vendor to provide sign language interpretation services, including in‑person, on‑site, and video‑remote interpretation for ASL, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages, and CART. The services will support ACS and its network of providers in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The procurement will be awarded via competitive sealed proposals for a contract term of July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services is procuring in‑person and video remote interpretation for spoken languages, Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing interpretation, and written translation services. The services are to support limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families accessing ACS programs. The work will be awarded through a competitive sealed‑proposal process to three vendors for contracts running July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide legal screenings and services to participants in the NYCitizenship Program, offering free assistance through the naturalization process. The effort is aimed at helping these clients become eligible for increased SSI benefits and reduce reliance on DSS benefits.

opportunities.title: Outside Land Use & Zoning Counsel with respect to the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay Project
opportunities.address: One Liberty Plaza, 165 Broadway, 14th Floor Mailroom, New York, NY 10006
opportunities.summary: NYCEDC is seeking law firms to provide outside legal counsel to analyze, draft, and review applications for tax lot apportionments and zoning lot subdivisions for Manhattan Tax Block 962, part of Lot 100, to support the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay development. The services will assist NYCEDC in preparing new building permit filings and related matters under a Request for Proposals.
